notes.title: Our new game is out!
notes.content:
[h2]Great news! Our more recent BL Visual Novel, [i][b]Lurkers[/b][/i], was released yesterday![/h2]

[i][b]Lurkers[/b][/i] is a short thriller revolving around the Jack the Ripper crimes. It features around 35k words, two suspects, three love interests, one bad ending if you choose the wrong culprit, and one good ending plus additional conclusions with the love interest of your choice, or a solo/friendship conclusion if you prefer. The rating is 15+.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34016683/2eaf8fc900cc69941dd478171fc65a9be9d00489.png[/img]

[h2][url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/1376840/Lurkers/]https://store.steampowered.com/app/1376840/Lurkers/[/url][/h2]

Come and have a taste of the grimmest side of Victorian England!

notes.title: New Game Demo Released!
notes.content:
We have the pleasure to announce the demo of [i][b]Lurkers[/b][/i] is now available for [b]Windows[/b] on the Steam store.

Experience the grimmest series of crimes of the Victorian era in this short [b]BL Yaoi Visual Novel,[/b] putting yourself in the shoes of the son of the first acknowledged victim of [b]Jack the Ripper[/b]. Follow Eddy Nichols in his quest for revenge and maybe find some love on the side!

Don't forget to add the game to your wishlist to be notified on the launch date!

notes.title: Untitled
notes.content:
Hello, I hope you're all healthy and fine!

Just a quick message to let you know [i][b]Night and Day[/b][/i], my new project, will be live on[b] Kickstarter[/b] next week, on [b]June 1st[/b].

[i][b]Night and Day[/b][/i] is a BL Visual Novel set in Paris in 1950, and it's a story about art, coming of age and jazz music. The demo is available on [b]Steam[/b] (Windows version only) and [b]itchio[/b] (Win, Linux and Mac), and although some side characters haven't got a sprite yet, the finished version will show all the characters. Apart from that and a couple of CGs missing, the demo is mostly in its final version, so please, check it out!

You can take a look at the preview page of the KS campaign here: 
[url=https://www.kickstarter.com/projects/night-and-day/night-and-day-0?ref=1wy02b&token=cefaf209]KICKSTARTER PREVIEW[/url]

I hope you like what you see! ;) 

Feedback about the page is most welcome: do you like the rewards and stretch goals or do you think something is missing? Any questions about the story or the game system?​

notes.title: Game update
notes.content:
All the minor bugs in the game have been now cleaned! 

Please, leave a comment if you find any other remaining issue. I've also added the "bara" tag to the store page so people are more aware of what kind of game this is (not only a Visual Novel, but a bara one).

For the ones who commented they would like more content like this from Ertal Games... I'm sorry, but bara is not really my cup of tea, hahaha! I just wanted to make a short game about gladiators, since I live in a town with a huge Roman heritage and I've seen many gladiators reenactments in my life, and they are really cool!

However, you can follow the artist's itchio, since he specializes in bara art and sometimes collaborates with other indie game devs; I'm sure you will find interesting stuff! [url=https://wolfscade.itch.io/]https://wolfscade.itch.io/[/url]

Thank you again for playing Blood and Lust! Don't forget to leave a review if you like it, even if it just says "nice game" ːsteammockingː

Everything should be working fine now, guys!

notes.title: Blood and Lust is in the review queue!
notes.content: I've been busy with the release of My Burning Heart, but this Monday Blood and Lust was sent to the review queue! So I hope it will be approved between today and tomorrow and we can finally have a Steam release!

notes.title: Release date delayed a few days!
notes.content:
Sorry for the inconvenience! We are currently making a video trailer for the game, since it's a requirement for the approval of the Steam page. 

Blood and Lust will be live as soon as the video is ready! ;)

The game is also being translated to Polish, so perhaps we'll wait until the translation is finished and can be added to the game, too; if we see that would delay the release too much, then we'll add it later as an update.

See you very soon!
